text: Bitcoin is holding steady near $64.6k while Ethereum has edged up slightly, suggesting cautious consolidation without conviction in either direction. The Fear & Greed index at 29 indicates persistent market unease, though the modest 7-day improvement hints at a slow thaw rather than a reversal. Total volume sits at $44B and BTC dominance remains elevated at 56.5%, pointing to a defensive stance where investors are favoring the largest assets over riskier altcoins.
